statistics_gate.rule: counts at the last severity level at which every material is fully supported

threshold_verdict: KEEP thresholds 0.35/0.10 with family-aware margin: evidence remains majority-supported through L3 (first majority flip at L4; critical: sio2-cu / nacl-cu). Statistics gate min_peak_counts = 100000 (derived at envelope level L3); the fused pipeline intentionally abstains from the gate boundary (L3) onward.
